proposals.before: I heard the Master say, "Heaven's Way is called round; earth's Way is called square," as I learned from the Master.'"
proposals.after: I once heard from the Master: "Heaven's Way is called round; earth's Way is called square."'"
proposals.reason: Chinese has one 嘗聞諸夫子 report; the idiomatic invents a second "as I learned from the Master" and drops 嘗.

proposals.before: in surveying carriage routes' longitude and latitude, the vault's calendar and the dome's chart.
proposals.after: in surveying the empire's longitude and latitude, he covered the vault of heaven and the breadth of earth.
proposals.reason: Literal "vault's calendar and the dome's chart" misreads 穹歷幅隕; 幅隕 is the classical earth-breadth phrase.

proposals.before: Wakhan lies thirteen degrees fifty-one minutes west of the capital;
proposals.after: Wokesi lies thirteen degrees fifty-one minutes west of the capital;
proposals.reason: Chinese 沃克什 is the same place as earlier Wokesi (s0263), not Wakhan (斡罕). The idiomatic English wrongly substitutes Wakhan.

proposals.before: Wakhan, west of the capital by thirteen degrees fifty-one minutes;
proposals.after: Wokesi, west of the capital by thirteen degrees fifty-one minutes;
proposals.reason: Literal English also mistranslates 沃克什 as Wakhan; it should match Wokesi used for the same Chinese name earlier in the chapter.

proposals.before: The above were additions of the Qianlong Board of Astronomy.
proposals.after: Above: Qianlong-era additions to the Shixian Calendar.
proposals.reason: Chinese 乾隆時憲所增 refers to Qianlong-era Shixian-calendar additions (as correctly rendered at s0266), not a Qianlong Board of Astronomy.

proposals.before: Right: additions under the Qianlong Directorate of Astronomy.
proposals.after: The above were additions to the Shixian Calendar during the Qianlong reign.
proposals.reason: Literal likewise invents a Directorate of Astronomy; 時憲 points to the Shixian calendar, parallel to s0266.

decisions.reason: 參嘗聞諸夫子曰 contains one report by Zengzi: he once heard the Master say the quoted words. The existing ending repeats that report and drops the force of 嘗.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 參嘗聞諸夫子曰：『天道曰圓，地道曰方。』

decisions.after: in surveying the maps' longitude and latitude, he traversed every corner of the realm.
decisions.reason: The proposal correctly rejects the astronomical reading, but its replacement still overreads the corrupted glyphs. A printed witness gives 偏歷幅隅, 'traversed every corner of the realm,' matching the terrestrial map context.

sourceWitness.citation: Qingshigao 26, opening preface, printed witness variant
sourceWitness.excerpt: 度輿圖經緯，則偏歷幅隅

decisions.reason: The focus text is 沃克什, identical to the place rendered Wokesi in the latitude list. Wakhan would require a different Chinese transcription.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 沃克什高三十度五十六分；... 沃克什偏西十三度五十一分

decisions.reason: The literal field must use the same Wokesi rendering for the repeated Chinese place-name 沃克什.
The same note at s0266 is correctly translated as Qianlong-era additions to the Shixian Calendar. 時憲 is not an astronomy board here.
This sentence repeats s0266 verbatim, so its literal translation should repeat the established Shixian Calendar sense rather than invent a directorate.
